fullDescription: Molimer is an elegant high-contrast serif typeface that combines refined editorial sophistication with a distinctive geometric edge. Its letterforms feature dramatic stroke contrast, sharp angular serifs, sculpted terminals, graceful curves, and expressive proportions that create a luxurious yet contemporary visual identity. Available in an extensive 18-style family with weights ranging from Thin to Black and matching italics, Molimer offers both delicate elegance and strong display impact. Its extended character set, multilingual support, and 350+ glyphs make it versatile for fashion editorials, luxury branding, magazine layouts, posters, film titles, beauty packaging, and sophisticated advertising.
